name: Gulf / US–Iran war
summary: UKMTO reported two tanker incidents off Khasab on 21 Nov; Trump calls Iran's terms unacceptable as talks continue
state: UKMTO reported two tanker incidents near Oman's Khasab on 21 Nov, and Iran said a vessel hit a mine east of Hormuz (US News/Reuters). On 20 Nov Araghchi said Iran wants diplomacy to end the war, while Trump called its terms unacceptable (US News/Reuters); on 21 Nov Araghchi set keeping enriched uranium as a red line (Times of Israel). Attacks on shipping and no ceasefire keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states, which may change at short notice. Seafarers should follow UKMTO guidance.
rubric_hit: Attacks on Gulf shipping, no ceasefire = Alert

sources.title: US News (Reuters) — UK maritime agency reports two tanker incidents near Oman; Iran says vessel hit mine east of Hormuz
US News (Reuters) — Araqchi says Iran wants diplomacy to end war, Trump says terms unacceptable

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
